tables.title: fMRIPrep's goodvoxels mask: fslstats' four calls
tables.note: fMRIPrep 25.2.6's goodvoxels workflow (`--project-goodvoxels`; not in the oracle runs) built from its code on ds005040's BOLD series in T1w space; each call on FSL's output of the fslmaths node before it (the fslmaths page shows those fourteen calls). The cortical ribbon is a stand-in, the segmentation's grey matter: the no-reconall oracle runs have no FreeSurfer ribbon. fMRIPrep reads each printed number as Python's float: the means divide the CoV images, mean + std / 2 is the threshold of -thr.

tables.note: `mean.nii.gz` and `std.nii.gz` are FSL's -Tmean and -Tstd of ds005040's BOLD series in T1w space (fMRIPrep's output, `bold.nii.gz`: 63 volumes), `mask.nii.gz` fMRIPrep's brain mask of it, `labels.nii.gz` fMRIPrep's segmentation at each BOLD voxel (1 grey matter, 2 white matter, 3 CSF), `t1w.nii.gz` fMRIPrep's preprocessed T1w. Each printed text compared byte for byte with FSL's (through the oracle cache): *identical*, every character of every line. The clean-room original (14 threads, and at one: the same text) is held to specs/fslstats.md §10: counts, extremes, coordinates, the robust range, percentiles, histograms, -w and the masked means and standard deviations identical, the other numbers (the unmasked means and standard deviations, -D, the entropies, the centres of gravity) within 1e-6 relative.
